title: gilbertiodendron quadrifolium
intro: Gilbertiodendron quadrifolium, commonly known as the Okangwe tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae, native to the tropical regions of Central and West Africa. The health benefits of Gilbertiodendron quadrifolium include its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms associated with fever and infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant are believed to be due to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of Gilbertiodendron quadrifolium include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
